# Register constants

Sources: `cmd/gendocs/constants.yaml`, checked against the register (Appendix A) of PLAN.md; `internal/gen/constants` is
generated from the same table.

Code reads these values only through the generated Go package `internal/gen/constants`. Every entry cites its register
rows (N and D) or the section of the plan that states it, and the generator fails when the cited text does not contain
the number, so a change of the register that is not followed here (or the reverse) breaks `make gen-docs`. The settings
that `deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml` also states (the exclusive lock timeout, `max_connections`, the TCP keepalives, the
role timeouts) have no value here: they are generated from that table (N139) and the plan check runs on the generated
value.

## Recall path

| Constant | Value | Register |
|---|---|---|
| `RerankMinRemaining` | `106 ms` | N106, D10 |
| `RecallCriticalPathP95Mid` | `236 ms` | N54, N176 |
| `PoolWaitP95` | `20 ms` | N164, N176 |
| `RecallP95Target` | `300 ms` | D3 |
| `RecallQPSPerShard` | `50` | D3 |
| `FilteredRecallP95` | `1000 ms` | N164 |
| `FilteredTheta` | `10,000` | N164, D3 |
| `FilteredFallbackFactor` | `4` | N164 |
| `ArmCapLow` | `50` | D10 |
| `ArmCapMid` | `150` | D10 |
| `ArmCapHigh` | `400` | D10 |
| `RerankTopLow` | `0` | D10 |
| `RerankTopMid` | `50` | D10 |
| `RerankTopHigh` | `150` | D10 |
| `RRFK` | `60` | D10 |
| `BoostMin` | `0.75 ratio` | D10 |
| `BoostMax` | `1.25 ratio` | D10 |
| `GraphSeeds` | `20` | D10 |
| `GraphNodeBudgetLow` | `100` | D10 |
| `GraphNodeBudgetMid` | `300` | D10 |
| `GraphNodeBudgetHigh` | `1000` | D10 |

- `RerankMinRemaining`: Rerank is skipped below this remaining deadline: rerank p95 90 + pack 3 + stream 5 + 8
- `RecallCriticalPathP95Mid`: Critical-path p95 of a MID recall, 216 ms of stages plus the pool-wait term
- `PoolWaitP95`: Pool-wait term: the maximum over six parallel arm acquisitions
- `RecallP95Target`: p95 target of an unfiltered MID recall at 50 QPS per shard
- `RecallQPSPerShard`: Recall rate per shard the SLO is stated for
- `FilteredRecallP95`: p95 of a filtered recall (a vector arm at E >= theta)
- `FilteredTheta`: Eligible rows above which a filtered vector arm leaves the exact path (theta)
- `FilteredFallbackFactor`: The fallback bound of the exact path is 4 theta rows
- `ArmCapLow`: Per-arm candidate cap at budget LOW
- `ArmCapMid`: Per-arm candidate cap at budget MID (also hnsw.ef_search)
- `ArmCapHigh`: Per-arm candidate cap at budget HIGH (also hnsw.ef_search)
- `RerankTopLow`: Fused candidates reranked at LOW
- `RerankTopMid`: Fused candidates reranked at MID
- `RerankTopHigh`: Fused candidates reranked at HIGH
- `RRFK`: Reciprocal rank fusion constant
- `BoostMin`: Lower clamp of the combined multiplicative boost
- `BoostMax`: Upper clamp of the combined multiplicative boost
- `GraphSeeds`: Seeds of the graph arm
- `GraphNodeBudgetLow`: Graph-arm node budget at LOW
- `GraphNodeBudgetMid`: Graph-arm node budget at MID
- `GraphNodeBudgetHigh`: Graph-arm node budget at HIGH

- `FenceRetryAfter`: retry_after of a refused shared fence try-lock (NamespaceFrozen)

  deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml: lock_timeout_exclusive)
- `ExclusiveStatementTimeout`: statement_timeout of the statement that takes the exclusive document lock
- `AppLockTimeout`: lock_timeout role default of engram_app (generated from deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml:
  roles.engram_app.lock_timeout)
- `MoveAdminLockTimeout`: lock_timeout role default of engram_move and engram_admin (generated from
  deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml: roles.engram_move.lock_timeout)
- `WriteStatementTimeout`: statement_timeout and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout of every write transaction
  (generated from deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml: roles.engram_app.statement_timeout)
- `SubjectLeasePoll`: Poll interval of pg_try_advisory_lock for the subject lease
- `SubjectLeaseMax`: Longest wait for a subject lease before UNAVAILABLE
- `LockSeedFence`: Seed of the namespace fence key
- `LockSeedDerivation`: Seed of the derivation lock key
- `LockSeedSubject`: Seed of the subject lock key
- `TCPKeepaliveIdle`: tcp_keepalives_idle of every shard and catalog server (generated from deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml:
  tcp_keepalives_idle)
- `TCPKeepaliveInterval`: tcp_keepalives_interval (generated from deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml: tcp_keepalives_interval)
- `TCPKeepaliveCount`: tcp_keepalives_count (generated from deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml: tcp_keepalives_count)
- `TCPUserTimeout`: tcp_user_timeout of every direct connection (generated from deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml:
  tcp_user_timeout)

- `HeartbeatEvery`: Heartbeat interval of an activity longer than 30 s

- `ExpungeContinueAsNewBatches`: Expunge continues as new every this many batches

- `RelayGapWatchlist`: The relay's gap watchlist horizon (a drawn seq commits or aborts within one writer timeout)

- `OutboxMaxEventBytes`: Encoded size of an outbox event (CHECK octet_length(payload) <= 16384)
- `OutboxElideAboveIDs`: Above this many ids an event is sent once with ids_elided

## Retry policies

Notation `initial / coefficient / max interval / max attempts / non-retryable error types` (PLAN.md 5.0); 0 attempts
means unlimited within the activity's `ScheduleToClose`.

| Policy | Initial | Coefficient | Max interval | Attempts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-pure` | 0s | 0.0 | 0s | 3 |
| `P-db` | 500ms | 2.0 | 10s | 10 |
| `P-frozen` | 1s | 1.5 | 5s | 0 |
| `P-llm` | 2s | 2.0 | 60s | 8 |
| `P-embed` | 1s | 2.0 | 30s | 8 |
| `P-blob` | 200ms | 2.0 | 5s | 10 |
| `P-poll` | 30s | 1.0 | 30s | 0 |
| `P-catalog` | 500ms | 2.0 | 5s | 20 |
| `P-cutover` | 100ms | 1.5 | 1s | 0 |
| `P-temporal` | 1s | 2.0 | 10s | 10 |

- `P-pure`: Chunk, GroupBatches, ApplyDeltaOps. Non-retryable: everything.
- `P-db`: every read and write transaction activity. Non-retryable: WrongShardOrEpoch, Validation, IntegrityViolation.
- `P-frozen`: write activities that may meet a freeze. Non-retryable: WrongShardOrEpoch, Validation, InputBlobMissing.
- `P-llm`: gateway structured and chat calls, after quota.Reserve. Non-retryable: PermanentLLMError, Validation,
  WrongShardOrEpoch.
- `P-embed`: gateway embed calls. Non-retryable: PermanentLLMError, Validation.
- `P-blob`: blob get, put, list, delete. Non-retryable: Validation.
- `P-poll`: batch-job polling (ScheduleToClose 48 h). Non-retryable: PermanentLLMError.
- `P-catalog`: catalog transactions in the move. Non-retryable: Validation, MovePrecondition.
- `P-cutover`: the cutover sub-step activities (ScheduleToClose 60 s). Non-retryable: Validation, MovePrecondition.
- `P-temporal`: activities that call the Temporal client. Non-retryable: Validation.
